g.ns7:text: \\flushleft\nFor (a) and (b) answer the following. \\\\\nThe margin $M$=2 for both.\\\\\n(1) Label as either soft or hard margin classifier.\\\\\n(2) Label as MMC or SVC.\\\\\n(3) Write the corresponding optimization problem.\\\\\n(4) For SVC, estimate $\\epsilon_i$ for each observation.\\\\\n(5) For SVC, find the budget $C$.
